hebrewText: כְּ/נֶ֨שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔/וֹ עַל גּוֹזָלָ֖י/ו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָי/ו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔/הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖/הוּ עַל אֶבְרָתֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: the eagle (or other large bird of prey)

tokens.kjv: (a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), [idiom] master, raise (up), stir up (self).

tokens.bdb: a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a nestling (as being comparatively nude of feathers)
to brood; by implication, to be relaxed
tokens.explanation: rachaph — planar, mover-se suavemente sobre algo

tokens.kjv: break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch (forth, out).

tokens.bdb: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
tokens.kjv: [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing
tokens.enLiteralWord: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing
tokens.explanation: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing
tokens.explanationEn: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.
